system.description:
Range: 1-space

You channel spiritual energy to empower your arms against supernatural foes.

Choose yourself or an ally within 1 space of you, and grant them one of the following effects until the start of your next turn:

  • Sacred Weapon

    • The chosen weapon gains the Magical and Rend traits and deals +1 Damage.

  • Sacred Shield

    • The chosen shield provides an additional +1 to Defense, and grants Advantage on checks to resist the effects of spells.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect.

Effects: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.16LbhO0UFsQODkM8]{Sacred Arms of the Arbiter (Shield)}, @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.XyJhOReFNg1zuEZA]{Sacred Arms of the Arbiter (Weapon)}
